messages.text:
Hey, I ordered a B30 Sept 12. Says should deliver around Nov 14. But I
don't see the batch # on your website. Goes up to Batch 3, I think mine was
batch 4 or 5.

order shop ····

What's the timeline looking like?

Hi,

Thanks for the order number. Before I can go into Shop····, I need one detail to match it to you. Please reply with the full name it ships to or the shipping postcode.

Once I have that I'll pull up the order and tell you which unit and batch it covers and its current ship date.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Felix,

Thanks, that matches. Your order Shop···· is paid and has your Harlo B30 plus the Power Kit. Both ship together in the same box.

You're right, yours is in batch 4. That's the batch we told you about in our September 15 delay notice, and your B30 ships November 14. Tracking comes to this email the moment it leaves the warehouse.

You can follow the B30 shipments on their way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Felix,

You're welcome. Before you go, one thing: what made you pick the B30 over the other miners you were considering?

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I wanted a newer asic with more efficient chips. I also ordered a magic
miner 40t from you guys  because it was best deal on bm1370 chips for a
home miner, and it was more efficient than the Avalon Q. I'd prefer a home
asic with closer to 1500 watt output, something that fits on a 15 amp plug.

Hi Felix,

That makes sense, and the BM1370 is exactly why the 40T has been so popular. What's pushing you toward the 1500 W size: more hashrate per outlet, or heat for a particular room?

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Yes, more hash, one machine, one outlet.

Hi Felix,

Thanks, that's really helpful. Your B30 tracking will come to this email as soon as it ships.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
